The '''Ministry of Commerce''' was the civilian agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] responsible for commercial affairs throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and was managed by the [[Minister of Commerce]]. In [[3963 BBY]] it suggested that news of [[Arkoh Adasca]]'s treachery be suppressed.
